title: 34 South Briland Main House | Royal Destinations
meta_description: 34 S Briland Lane Gulf Front Main House at Beach Access Rosemary Beach
description_expanded: Description: 34 S Briland Lane Main House by Royal Destinations Address: 34 S Briland Lane Location: Rosemary Beach - Gulf Front - At Beach Access Details: Experience the charm of Rosemary Beach, where coastal beauty meets effortless relaxation. This south of 30A Gulf front home offers Gulf views and direct beach access, putting you just steps from the sand and the heart of town. Spend your days lounging on the private beach, swimming in one of four community pools, or exploring on one of the four included beach cruiser bikes. Guests also enjoy access to the Fitness Center and Racquet Club (for an additional fee) and can stroll to boutiques, local dining, the weekly Farmers Market, and live music just moments away. With dining for six, street parking, and every comfort thoughtfully designed, this Rosemary Beach retreat is the perfect blend of style, convenience, and coastal serenity. Book your stay with Royal Destinations and let our team craft a 30A experience you’ll never forget. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: - Distance to Beach Access: At Beach Access - Carriage House with Gulf Views - Parking Spaces: Street Parking Only (Home is Adjacent to Beach Boardwalk) - Dining Accommodations: 6 at Dining Table - South of 30A Carriage House of Gulf Front Home Community Highlights: - Private Community Beach - Private Beach - 4 Neighborhood Pools - Fitness Center and Racquet Club Access (Extra Charge) - 4 Adult Bikes - Timpoochee Trail - Village Shopping, Dining, Entertainment Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 6 4 Beds / 3 Full Baths / 1 Half Bath First Floor: - Bedroom 1: King Bed, Attached Bath with Tub/Shower Combo - Bedroom 2: King Bed, Attached Bath with Shower, Sitting Area -Laundry Room Second Floor: - Bedroom 3: Bunk Room Twin/Twin - Living Room, Full Kitchen, Dining Room, Half Bath, Porch with Panoramic Gulf Views Third Floor: - Bedroom 4: Queen Bed, Private Bath with Shower Please Note: *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
